info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Endpoint Configuration API
info.description: This API facilitates the configuration of webhook endpoints within the system, enabling businesses to set up notifications for key events. Users can update existing webhook settings to define how and when they receive data from various services. Typical consumers include developers integrating third-party applications or internal systems needing real-time updates. This operation supports customizing endpoint behaviors, improving automation and responsiveness to critical events.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific webhook endpoint identified by RES-100045. Provide the necessary changes in the request body to modify the existing configuration.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the configuration of the specified webhook endpoint identified by 'RES-100045'. The payload must conform to the specified JSON schema, which outlines the necessary fields and their expected data types.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource was updated.
